title: RUN
blurb: One syllable, total urgency, and absolutely no supporting information. The design withholds everything: you are not told what is coming, only that remaining here has stopped being viable, and your imagination supplies something worse than any explanation could. It works as the internet's evacuation order for anything approaching, escalating or deteriorating at speed. Drop it over a video the instant the situation turns. Use it in a call when somebody opens with 'so I've been thinking about the flat'. Leave now, ask later.
